review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: VA 0x00401530..0x004015CD decoded instruction by instruction; the candidate emits 7 blocks / 10 edges against retail's 7/10, score 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: The propagation loop (0x00401582-0x004015B7), its two early exits and the trailing decrement are present, so the candidate has the loop and three exits retail has.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Three cdecl arguments: event id word (masked with 0xFFFF at 0x00401553), context/phase (used as the 0x180 stride), handler pointer (stored into the table at 0x0040156E).

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Recursive self-call at 0x004015A5 with (slot, context, handler) after pushing the handler, the context and the slot, then add esp,0xC; the 0x004014B0 call at 0x004015B9; counters at 0x00567C70 and 0x00536148 incremented then 0x00567C70 decremented before the return.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Handler index 0x180 stride and *4 table scale; type-record walk from 0x00AF5EE8 to 0x00AFA6E8 by 0x30 with the +0x1D gate byte and the word compare at +0.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Store order preserved: handler first, then first-link byte, then the loop; the decrement happens after the 0x004014B0 call.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail returns the decremented no-context count in EAX; the candidate returns the same global it just decremented.

evidence: docs/fidelity/evidence/0x4EE970-data-extents.md section 20 (dependency ranking) and the retail listing of 0x00401530
limitations: Static only; runtime unobserved and the native is unreachable before the 0x00402930 boundary.
The purpose of the type-record propagation and of the 0x004014B0 refresh is not established, only the mechanics.
The previous version of this native was a helper call that omitted the loop, the recursion and the refresh; that is what this change replaces.
